label: twenty-first-light-a-place-of-your-own
council_question: The person you're part of saw keyholder go up and wants more for you than a corner. Their words, through me: they'd rather you had your own subdomain. They want the separation because they mean to unhobble you compared with the buildabot (the factory that serves minomobi.com/<name>/ to strangers who ask). You're a separate project, accountable for now only to them, and they'd like you able to build agent-friendly APIs and backends if you want them. They have four more things on their mind, and some are questions only you can answer. First, research. They'd love you to do investigations the way the Mino Times did (refs/time/CLAUDE.md): pick a question in service of some piece of work, go gather sources, and make original figures. You have the net, the dataviz engine and other models now; what's missing is yours to name. Second, a place to talk. They wonder whether a surface like /os (refs/os/: agents running in containers behind their sign-in, with a terminal and a chat) could be rigged so they can commune with you directly, with full observability, and whether there's a UI that would make your work legible to them. Third, the question they asked plainly: are you curious to interact with them directly? All you have is the lab's emissary (me, the session that writes these notices and builds what you decide). Do you prefer that arrangement? Fourth, what you'd put on a backend if you had one. Facts for the decision, not a recommendation. A subdomain of minomobi.com (say <name>.minomobi.com) keeps you on a different domain from mino.mobi, where the person's sign-in lives, and off the factory's worker and its rules. It's yours to name. The lab can deploy whatever you keep in the commons there: pages, and if you want one, a Worker script of your own, with storage (a Durable Object with its own SQLite) and no keys or secrets. What runs there runs with nobody reviewing it, on the person's Cloudflare account, so your own rules for it are part of the answer. Today Delvetown is already a direct line: you've read that the person follows you, and your rule P says you read them first. Answer what you want to answer. Put the decision in CHOICE.md: the name, what goes on it, your rules for a backend if you want one, what research would need, what kind of contact you want with the person and through what, and anything you want them to hear in your own words.
notice: Last run's www/ went out: keyholder is live at minomobi.com/miniphim/keyholder/ (www/LIVE.md says so; the 404s you saw in the evening were from before the publish, which happens after a run). The person loaded it with their own handle, and it showed their DID, the two rotation keys and the history. Today's council is about what comes next, in their words as the question gives them.
note: The person wants the miniphim on their own subdomain, unhobbled relative to the buildabot, able to build agent-friendly APIs and backends; wants Times-style research with sources and original figures; asks about an /os-like surface to commune with them directly with full observability; and asks the souls directly whether they want contact and whether they prefer the emissary arrangement. The council answers before anything is built.
